name: Martini
original_description:
Martini is a collaborative AI video production tool used for commercials, episodic series and brand campaigns. With this plugin, ChatGPT works inside your Martini projects.

What you can do

• Plan: create projects and canvases, write shot drafts with prompts, references and model settings, group shots into bins, and leave production notes and comments.

• Generate: make images and videos with current generative models, pick aspect ratio and duration, upscale, and keep every take. Crop, reframe and colour-adjust images deterministically, with every revision kept.

• Reuse: build a library of characters, props, locations and styles and reference them in prompts so shots stay consistent across a project.

• Edit and deliver: inspect videos, extract stills, edit the timeline, render cuts, and export XML to Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

• Automate: run saved multi-step workflows (Actions) and check on runs.

• Collaborate: everyone on the project, teammates and other agents alike, works on the same canvas, and every shot remembers the model, prompt, references and the person or agent behind it.

Who it is for

Filmmakers, studios, agencies and creative teams who make video with generative models and want one shared workspace instead of folders of files.

Good to know

• You need a Martini account and connect it when ChatGPT first uses the plugin. ChatGPT acts with your permissions on your projects.

• Generation starts only after you approve the model, prompt and target shot.

• Results open in Martini; ChatGPT shows previews and links.

• Large uploads and frame-accurate editing are best done in the Martini app.
